title: GEMSDOE33 — Fault Discovery with Bounded Analog-Field Transfer
description: DOE GEMS Prize fault-discovery repository (DrivenData competition 306) whose standing directive requires a unique GeoTIFF submission and an easy-to-download file. Its brief asks for ground truth borrowed from better-mapped analog geothermal fields (Dixie Valley, Desert Peak, Brady’s) with the transfer itself bounded by domain-adaptation theory and a measured source-to-target feature divergence before the transfer is trusted. The directory summarises the stated method and asserts no result.
